workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes M2526 design into machine-readable protected rows gates and config patch plan before repair implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: engineering-controller failure-surface intervention plan materialization only; no rollout, simulation, policy action, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate verdict, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, driver-performance, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if protected rows cannot be traced to M2521-M2524 artifacts
stop if the materialized spec requires hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if candidate config patch plan would overwrite active training configs
stop if artifact contents imply ranking success-rate or validation verdict claims
fallback_plan: route to design repair if protected rows or gates cannot be materialized
route to source-only implementation preflight only after all plan artifacts pass
route to branch synthesis if the intervention branch accumulates repeated non-evidence milestones
stop for user review if no bounded repair path remains

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2527 materializes Route A intervention plan artifacts and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2527; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2521-M2526 measured behavior and intervention-design artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization shows the intervention requires oracle inputs or rule switching, fail the milestone and route to synthesis rather than weakening self-ID or validation gates.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, driver-performance verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: converts intervention design into structured artifacts required for future repair implementation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: does not decide paper verdict but prepares a controlled Route A repair implementation path

hypothesis: A materialization preflight can turn the M2526 failure-surface intervention design into traceable protected rows gates and config patch artifacts before any repair implementation or training.
success_criteria: summary verifies P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3 unchanged
summary verifies training_started false policy_action false active_config_overwritten false and false claim flags
protected rows trace to M2521-M2524 source artifacts
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution environment rollout policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2527 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2527 changes actor input or action contract
M2527 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2527 executes policy action or rollout
M2527 starts training or overwrites an active config
M2527 treats intervention materialization as driver performance
M2527 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2527 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2527 passes if it materializes traceable intervention-plan artifacts with no actor contract change, no hidden/oracle actor input, no active config overwrite, no policy action, no training, no ranking, no winner selection, no success-rate verdict, and no validation or performance claim.
